content:
Marta (PM): quick heads-up: i'm assembling a crisp GA "floor" for launch readiness. aim is to keep it minimal but safe: SLA floor, basic latency targets, docs bundle, support routing, monitoring canaries, and a published price floor. calling owners now.

Ike (Infra): i'll own perf validation and autoscale smoke. note: GPU memory fragmentation on long seqs is still tracked as tech-debt, will document mitigation.

Chen (SRE): monitoring/runbooks owner here. required for GA: synthetic canary for latency+correctness, p99 alert for tail latency, and a tested fallback to smaller model-variants. need a region-failover checklist in CI.

Marta (PM): SLA proposal: Dedicated 99.9% monthly uptime; Hosted 99.5% initial. we publish latency guidance (p50/p95) per model family rather than hard SLOs for all cases.

Ravi (FinOps): pricing floor: i'll publish a GA floor sheet (hosted tokens, embeddings, reserved tiers) with example commit scenarios. enterprise tiers can be marked as "finalizing".

Ike (Infra): blockers: autoscale burst validation (>1k rps synthetic burst) and KV-cache cold-start regression test. i'll submit the smoke PR by Tue.

launch-bot: created ticket LR-7001 (autoscale-smoke) and LR-7002 (regional-failover-drill), assignees: Ike, Chen.

Chen (SRE): also need a runbook for degraded-quality fallback (route to quantized variant) + a test to prove it under load. that is GA-blocking.

Marta (PM): adding that to acceptance. Proposed minimal acceptance (react :thumbsup: to approve):

```
GA MINIMAL ACCEPTANCE (owners)
- SLA: Dedicated 99.9%, Hosted 99.5% (owner: Marta)
- Latency guidance: publish p50/p95 by model family; infra to target p95 <= 200ms for short requests (owner: Ike)
- Monitoring: synthetic canaries (latency + correctness) + p99 tail alerts (owner: Chen)
- Runbooks: SEV1/SEV2 playbooks + degraded-model fallback documented and tested (owner: Chen)
- Autoscale & Failover: autoscale smoke harness + scripted regional failover CI job (owners: Ike/Chen)
- Docs: GA quickstart, migration notes for pilots, operational expectations (owner: Marta)
- Support: business-hours triage + SEV1 on-call escalation path documented (owner: Marta)
- Pricing: published GA floor + example commits (owner: Ravi)
```

Ravi (FinOps): i'll share the draft floor and two commit examples by Friday.

Ike (Infra): :thumbsup: will prioritize autoscale smoke. marking mem-frag as deferred with mitigation.

Chen (SRE): :thumbsup: pending degraded-model fallback test and failover tickets.

Marta (PM): i'll lock this as the go-live operability floor for the next shiproom unless someone calls a hard blocker by EOD. thanks.
